purpose: Candid semantic-support gap diagnostic, not an accuracy or pass benchmark.
provenance: All passages and answers are original fictional English text composed for this diagnostic. No religious text, real user facts, external source acquisition or model/provider calls.
review: Fixture author reviewed exact quotes, labels and rationales. verified=true denotes local synthetic fixture review only, not independent scholarly review or runtime corpus admission.

label_policy.supported: The complete supplied passages support the answer.
label_policy.contradicted: The complete supplied passages explicitly state an incompatible fact.
label_policy.not-established: The supplied passages establish neither the answer nor its negation. Unknown facts are not assumed false.
